content.short: Phantom Wallet is a leading multichain crypto wallet on Solana, Ethereum, and Polygon.
content.description: Phantom Wallet is a non-custodial wallet designed for Solana-based assets, providing secure storage and a streamlined experience for trading, receiving, sending, and storing supported tokens. It supports hardware wallets, notably Ledger, for tighter security. Phantom is available on mobile devices and as a browser extension, offering a consistent wallet experience across platforms. In May 2023 it expanded wallet support to Polygon and Ethereum, continuing its network growth while preserving user control over private keys.
